title: DeepSeek releases DeepSeek Harness under the MIT license in developer preview, touting a design where "every capability is a plugin" that can be swapped out (Carl Franzen/VentureBeat)
summary: Carl Franzen / VentureBeat: DeepSeek releases DeepSeek Harness under the MIT license in developer preview, touting a design where “every capability is a plugin” that can be swapped out — DeepSeek is expanding beyond the model layer and deeper into the software developers use to put AI agents to work.
